blocks.x: OEE +7.2 points across 14 plants — sensor fabric to scheduling decisions
A global automotive OEM — Manufacturing & Industrial engagement delivered by a 31-person team over 20 months, Global scope, commercial model: build-transfer.

items: Legacy lines uninstrumented; OEE components estimated; changeover losses structurally accepted.
Quality escapes discovered at customer complaints; inspection by sampling.
Flat plant networks left lines exposed to ransomware.

blocks.x: We retrofitted sensor fabric on live lines (OPC UA/Sparkplug with data contracts), deployed vision inspection closing loops into andon/MES, and gave planners a Swarm scheduling assistant proposing changeover-aware sequences. IEC 62443 zoning preceded instrumentation — security first, then telemetry, then decisions on Forge.

Delivery followed the standard rhythm — Diagnose with a signed baseline, Prove with falsifiable criteria, Industrialize with staged rollouts — while the control evidence (model cards, decision replay, security tests) accumulated as artifacts of the build.

items: Trial eligibility matching at 10x — enrollment windows met

items: the decision/data architecture pattern, the control matrix and the run model — adapted per estate in weeks, not quarters.
organizational absorption: adoption paths are designed for each client's operating culture, never assumed.
